proof_body:
by
  intro a c
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, ht⟩ ε K hε
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 ht ε hε
    refine ⟨p (max M K), (le_max_right M K).trans hp.le_apply, ?_⟩
    have h1 := hM (max M K) (le_max_left _ _)
    rwa [Real.dist_eq] at h1
  · intro h
    have hf : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, |a n - c| < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := fun k =>
      Filter.frequently_atTop.2 fun K => h _ K (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hp2⟩ := Filter.extraction_forall_of_frequently hf
    refine ⟨p, hp, Metric.tendsto_atTop.2 fun ε hε => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hε
    refine ⟨M, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have h2 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 / ((M : ℝ) + 1) := by
      apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
      have h3 : (M : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      linarith
    exact ((hp2 n).trans_le h2).trans hM
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∃ p : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono p ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a (p n)) Filter.atTop (nhds c)) ↔ ∀ (ε : ℝ) (K : ℕ), 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, K ≤ n ∧ |a n - c| < ε
